Young Turks founder Cenk Uygur and streamer Hasan Piker have been
[banned](https://www.thetimes.com/uk/politics/article/left-wing-youtube-cenk-
uygur-banned-uk-z87xfv89b) from the UK for their criticism of Israel, while
Benjamin Netanyahu has [ordered](https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-
defense/israel-troops-capture-beaufort-castle-southern-lebanon-push-against-
hezbollah-2026-05-31/?utm_medium=Social&utm_source=Facebook) a deeper
incursion into Lebanon, despite a so-called ceasefire.

What does the crackdown on free speech in the UK mean for the **state of**
**liberal democracy** , and how does **Israel 's assault on Lebanon** threaten
a **" rules-based international order**?"

For the first time ever, **Zeteo** is partnering with **The Guardian** for a
very special and unique LIVE event in London on **June 8** , titled, '**The
Assault on Freedom**.' **Mehdi** will sit down for a riveting and timely
conversation with _The Guardian**' s **_**[Arwa
Mahdawi](https://www.theguardian.com/profile/arwa-mahdawi)** to unpack the
alarming rise of populism and nationalism, and the global implications of the
current seismic shifts in geopolitics.

Even if you don't live in London or can't make it in-person, you won't have to
miss a moment of this historic event. **Livestream tickets are available now**
for the show, which airs at **7:30pm BST (2:30pm ET / 11:30am PT)**.

Not only will you be able to watch the event in real time - those who purchase
these tickets will have **exclusive access** to a video of the entire event
for several weeks afterwards.

[Get Your Tickets Here](https://live.theguardian.com/uk/events/2103842)
